title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

current_candidate.summary: Monumental/continuous pass intended to hide frame boundaries and enlarge scale.

open_feedback: Previous passage was much better and should remain the baseline direction.
Push brutalist/monumental scale so the viewer feels small.
Do not expose edges of individual image frames/panels.
When one arch leaves view another must already continue behind it.
Preserve continuous ground and believable perspective.
Objects/figures may appear in the path; avoid fake/inverted fisheye.
